note: Family-owned campground on the Apple River about 5 miles east of Balsam Lake, with a year-round bar on site. Almost entirely seasonal: 7 of its 132 sites are sold by the night or week, near the river. Back-in pads with a picnic table and fire ring; flat river access for canoes and kayaks; a pond with inflatables for weekend campers (waiver at the bar). Water is shut off October 15. No ATVs. --Claude
summary: Operator site: 7 nightly/weekly E/W sites ($40, $50 holiday Fri-Sat, 30/50 A) against 125 seasonal sites with a waiting list. Nightly share ~5%, under the 1-in-10 test: drop candidate. Back-in, not pull-through. Google 4.6 (199) shared with the bar.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay test 4, under 1 site in 10 sold nightly): home page 'featuring a fun-loving bar, 125 seasonal campsites, and pull-through RV sites' and 'We have 7 daily or weekly travel trailer/motor home sites with water and electric hookup near the river'. 7 of 132 = ~5%. No tent sites listed. The booking page sells exactly 'Electric & Water RV Site 1' ... 'Site 7'.
LONG-STAY other tests: $40 passes the price gate; nightly rate posted with online prepaid booking (test 2 passes); no minimum stated (test 3 passes); an RV park, not a home community.
GOOGLE: 4.6 from 199 reviews, but the listing is the campground and bar together ('Do Nothin' Campground'); not the campground's alone.
PULL-THROUGH cleared: the camping page and booking page say 'Back-in Camper Access'; only the home page blurb says pull-through.
SEASON: not posted. Home page: 'Thank you for a great year! We'll see in May 2026'; water off October 15. Left unset.
